votes.motion: A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to direct Administration to begin implementing the FY 2024 Budget as amended, authorizing expending funds up to the $5.124 million dollars, and to allow Administration discretion with regard to the utilization of those funds

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to convene a closed session in the Mayor's Conference Room to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and to adjourn the Council meeting immediately following the closed session
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham, to approve the Consent Calendar
